title: feat(c00firstfill): lex-first seed that (1,0,0,0,0) fills
science: Anomaly in the runner output the note does not call out: for f00=(1,0,0,0,0) the coverage profile by seed size is cov1..cov6 = 0,0,0,7,0,4 - fill is NOT monotone in seed size (every one of the 792 five-site seeds fails although seven four-site faces fill). Adding a lock can convert a firing wt1 cell into a refused opp2/adj2 cell, so supersets of a filling seed can stop filling.
